title: Modest Mouse: We Were Dead Before the Ship Even Sank
description: A companion to the band set: the highlights, key tracks and stories behind the 2007 album that went to No. 1.

cards.prompt: In what year was We Were Dead Before the Ship Even Sank released?
cards.details: It arrived three years after Good News for People Who Love Bad News, with the band riding high on "Float On".

cards.prompt: Where did We Were Dead debut on the US Billboard 200 album chart?
cards.details: The band's first No. 1, which is remarkable for an album this odd and seafaring.

cards.prompt: Which big-name new member co-wrote and played guitar across this album?
cards.details: The former Smiths guitarist's chiming parts are woven all through the record. This is the album he's on.

cards.prompt: What recurring theme runs through the album's title and songs?
cards.details: Ships, sailors, sinking and drowning run all the way through it. Even the title is a shipwreck joke.
Brock is at full howl from the start, and the title announces the nautical theme straight away.

cards.prompt: What was the album's lead single?
cards.details: A funky, strutting single in the "Float On" tradition: upbeat music over lyrics about things going wrong.

cards.prompt: Complete the single's title, which fits the album's seafaring theme: "___ the Boat"
cards.details: "Missed the Boat" is one of the album's gentlest, prettiest songs, with backing vocals from a famous guest (next card).

cards.prompt: Which frontman of The Shins sings backing vocals on the album?
cards.details: Mercer's sweet high harmonies are a lovely contrast to Brock's rasp.

cards.prompt: Who produced We Were Dead Before the Ship Even Sank?
cards.details: Herring had also worked with the band on Good News for People Who Love Bad News.

cards.prompt: Which track title mashes together "steam engine" and "genius"?
cards.details: Brock loves wordplay. This one sounds like a steampunk invention.

cards.prompt: Which song title pictures an insect stuck in a glass container?
cards.details: A very Modest Mouse image: something small, trapped, buzzing in circles.

cards.prompt: Which track title sounds like "parting of the sea" but isn't?
cards.details: Fans often single it out as one of the album's most dramatic songs.

cards.prompt: Which song title describes a small roadside place to sleep?
cards.details: One of the album's slower, more tender moments, in contrast to the rowdy singles.
